directory_policies.notes.2: Degree background: An accredited bachelor degree in STEM is required. Final equivalency is determined by UW.
directory_policies.notes.3: GRE policy: GRE scores are neither required nor accepted.
directory_policies.notes.4: Deadlines: Autumn 2027: January 5 priority and March 5 for international full-time applicants; May 14 is restricted to part-time applicants and working professionals.

source_excerpt: GRE scores are no longer required or accepted
fact_summary: The PMP page supports the STEM bachelor requirement and no-GRE policy; its three dated rounds have different audiences.
